claim_boundary: the absolute-shock mechanism was generated after observing both tails over development and historical validation
no historical segment is independent OOS and all p-values are descriptive consistency diagnostics
a pass creates a prospective forward-test candidate only
a failure closes this exact entry-only interaction without cutoff, factor, target-size, buffer, or holding-period rescue

genesis.observed_pattern: both the most negative and most positive industry-size-neutral weekly-return tails underperformed the all-eligible benchmark

shock_measure.raw_return: decision close divided by the fifth prior observed stock close minus one
shock_measure.neutralization: weekly OLS on intercept, zscore log free-float market cap, and sorted SW2021_L1 industry dummies

arms.F_BASELINE: retain prior names if factor_rank<=75, then fill by factor_rank and symbol to 50
arms.F_STABLE_ENTRY: retain prior names if factor_rank<=75 regardless of current shock; fill only from factor-ranked candidates inside the stable new-entry pool

execution.outcome: fifth common market-session open return from entry
execution.missing_or_untradable_slot: zero return cash proxy with completeness reported

statistics.primary_estimand: weekly F_STABLE_ENTRY net return minus F_BASELINE net return at 40bps

decision_rules.retrospective_candidate: full-sample paired improvement>=0.10% weekly; one-sided HAC p<0.05; bootstrap q05>0; every fixed subperiod paired mean>0; every fixed subperiod F_STABLE_ENTRY net mean>0; observable rate>=98%; full compounded max drawdown<=35%
decision_rules.cost_stress: at 60bp full paired mean and bootstrap q05 remain positive and every fixed subperiod F_STABLE_ENTRY net mean remains positive
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_STABLE_ENTRY_CANDIDATE_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if all descriptive consistency and cost-stress rules pass
decision_rules.failure_status: HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED_RETROSPECTIVE; no cutoff, factor, target-size, buffer, or holding-period rescue
